resources.string: YouTube is being difficult
YouTube is refusing this request and may need you to verify your sign-in. Check Sources → YouTube, or the YouTube account linked to Spotify, then retry. If the login is correct, wait a few minutes.
Cannot connect right now
We cannot reach the service. Check your Wi-Fi or mobile connection, then try again.
The service is taking too long
The request took longer than expected. Try again in a little while.
Sign-in needed
This content requires an account. Open Sources, sign in to the service and check that your account can access it.
The service needs a break
Too many requests were sent to the service. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
The source has a problem
We could not load this content. Try again; if the problem continues, update the source from Settings → Sources.
This content is unavailable
The service is not making this content available. It may have been removed or made private. Try another item.
Unavailable in your region
The service does not make this content available in your current region.
Cannot play this format
Try another quality or content. If it keeps happening, update the source and the app.
The service refused access
Check your sign-in and try again. If access still fails, update the source from Settings → Sources.
This content is protected
The service could not authorize protected playback. Check your account and subscription; downloading this content may not be allowed.
